subject: Staging priming + hands-on session — routing & load-test coordination
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightway.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@brightway.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC hands-on: scheduling + environment checklist

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Brightway is excited to move to a hands-on session where we validate routing and run a brief load-test with our sample prompts. We'd like to schedule a 90-minute working session that includes: prompt review, routing policy walkthrough, and a 15-minute controlled load test against a staging endpoint.

Before we lock a time, can you confirm the following for the staging environment?
- Staging endpoint URL and any basic auth or header tokens we should use
- Sandbox service account for our infra team (temporary keys are fine)
- IP ranges for VPC allowlist (we can push config changes on Mon/Tue next week)
- Any quota/limits we should be aware of during the load test

I've attached a brief agenda and our preferred time windows next week (PST). Preferably Wed or Thu morning.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khan
Director, Integrations — Brightway Health
Samir.Khan@brightway.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: poc-agenda-brief.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC hands-on: scheduling + environment checklist

Hi Samir — great to hear. We're available to run a 90-min hands-on and will cover prompt tuning, routing behavior, and a controlled load test. Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2026-11-30 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-12-01 09:00–10:30

Pre-checks from our side:
- We'll provision a staging endpoint and create a sandbox service account (short-lived key) once we have the primary contact for your infra team.
- We need your allowlist CSV (IP ranges + CIDR) by EOD Mon 2026-11-29 to unblock the Wed slot. I've attached our allowlist template.
- For the load test: please confirm target RPS and sample prompt set (we can run a 500–1000 token scenario for up to 2 minutes). We will throttle if latency rises above SLO.

Looping in Rishi (solutions) and Priyom (infra) to confirm technical timing and to share the routing test checklist. Rishi — can you confirm availability for both slots? Priyom — we'll need the staging endpoint created in the us-west-2 region and a short window for TCP/IP allowlist changes.

I'll send a run-of-show once the slot is confirmed.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC hands-on: scheduling + environment checklist

Hi all — I can do both Wed and Thu slots; prefer Wed so we can iterate during the same week. A few technical notes for the pre-check: 
- Please add these outgoing IP ranges to your allowlist: 52.7.12.0/24, 3.120.45.0/24, 34.201.8.0/23.
- We will create a sandbox service account with two keys: one for the demo (read-only routing traffic) and one for the load test (isolated token). Keys expire after 48h by default — tell us if you need a longer window.
- Routing test: bring 3 canonical prompts (happy path, ambiguous, and long-context). We'll exercise policy fallbacks and KV cache hit rates.

I've uploaded a short checklist we use for routing validation to the Drive folder and attached a local copy.

Cheers,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: routing-test-checklist.txt

Thanks — we can do Wed 11/30 at 10am PST. Samir will join along with myself and one engineer (Jae Park). A few quick asks so we can finalize: 
- Can you confirm the exact staging URL and an expiration for the sandbox key? We prefer keys that expire after the session (24–48h).
- We'll push the allowlist on Mon night — please confirm that's fine for a Wed morning session.
- For the load test, target ~20 concurrent requests for ~90s using our sample prompt file. We'll use the read-only token while engineering observes metrics.

Hannah — could you send the run-of-show and the staging endpoint link + ephemeral key once provisioned? Also please include any rate-limits we should respect during the test so our SRE doesn't accidentally trigger alerts.

Appreciate the quick coordination.
